report:
Reviewed the complete claim and all six implementation entries and five test entries. Requirements: explicit and elided local lifetimes, universally bound and existential/inferred origins, imported lifetimes, and synthesized lifetimes all become Dummy; Dummy has no static, lifetime inference-variable, or post-analysis-erasure meaning; omitting lifetime semantics must not introduce ambiguity. The single-variant Lifetime enum in ty.rs establishes the representation and its deliberate deferred semantics. cst/ty.rs ignores the source lifetime and builds Dummy immediately during signature checking; check/expr.rs does the same for local type syntax, reference expressions, and string literal reference types. external_syms.rs lower_ty maps every RawTy::Ref to Dummy while recursively lowering its referent. local_syms/fns.rs builds Dummy for borrowed implicit receivers, and check/infer_ctx.rs adjust_method_receiver builds Dummy for synthesized borrowed method receivers. These are construction-time values, not inference variables or an erasure pass. Added associations at these essential boundaries and restarted the review afterward. Captured impl signature and trait_env lowering show lifetime parameters/bounds are deliberately ignored for type-only obligations rather than marked unsupported; the captured unification fragment does not treat Dummy as a universe-sensitive variable.
Test assessment: explicit_elided_and_static_lifetimes_collapse_to_dummy inspects every parameter and return type for &'a, elided &, and &'static references and requires solver eligibility. lifetime_generic_impl_uses_dummy_and_remains_solver_eligible inspects a universally lifetime-parameterized impl's reference Self and its eligibility. clone_method_call_is_elaborated_to_a_resolved_trait_call visibly checks the synthesized receiver is a shared reference with Dummy in a diagnostic-free resolved trait call. comparisons_materialize_signature_required_shared_borrows visibly checks both operands for eq and lt are shared Dummy references in diagnostic-free resolved calls, with cold/warm execution through the captured harness. Fixture and helper reads establish these are actual parsed/checked inputs and metadata-backed operations, not stand-in assertions. These tests would catch retaining static/named lifetimes, omitting receiver borrowing, or treating ordinary lifetime omission as unsupported. The remaining types_lifetimes_dummy entry is explicitly TODO: imported/bound/inferred-origin-specific coverage remains deferred. Its prerequisite is completing those origin-specific fixtures and asserting their lowered values; it is not passing behavioral evidence and does not defer production lowering, which is present at the captured construction boundaries. The ordinary tests provide local and synthesis coverage; they are not claimed to exhaust the outstanding origin matrix.
Executed cargo fmt and cargo build successfully (existing warnings). Executed cargo test -p sage-test-harness lifetimes --lib (2 passed, including the associated explicit/elided/static test); cargo test -p sage-test-harness lifetime_generic_impl_uses_dummy_and_remains_solver_eligible --lib (1 passed); cargo test -p sage-test-harness clone_method_call_is_elaborated_to_a_resolved_trait_call --lib (1 passed); cargo test -p sage-oracle-harness --test binary_operators comparisons_materialize_signature_required_shared_borrows (1 passed). No behavioral violation was reproduced. Reviewed source evidence and the explicit test deferral separately from these executions. Centralized post-codegen and Sage sanity review of the comment-only edits is coordinated by root.
